control.finding: Neutral Utility calibrates the minimum generic hierarchy and cannot survive by contract.

F1.name: Ratio Ladder
F1.finding: The bounded size ratio produces a materially clearer hierarchy than CNEG in APP and WEB, remains coherent at 320px, and stays subordinate to C0/MAT rather than competing as the primary identity carrier. Its distinction remains recoverable without color, custom typeface, wordmark, or accidental line-break dependence.

F2.name: Weight Plane
F2.finding: Weight is spread across eyebrow, heading and state roles until the surface reads as familiar dashboard/utilitarian bold hierarchy. The mechanism is legible but not materially Kymaean-specific under the frozen genericity criterion.

F3.name: Measure Plane
F3.finding: Its distinction is carried primarily by constrained text measure and resulting line breaks. APP/WEB remain related, but the authored character reads as a layout trick whose identity depends too heavily on line-break behavior, matching the frozen falsification risk.

F4.name: Rhythm Plane
F4.finding: The interval changes remain too close to CNEG to establish a materially distinct supportive role grammar; where visible, they read as generic editorial whitespace rather than a transferable Kymaean mechanism.

authority: F1 is provisional role-grammar evidence only. System-ui remains a measurement carrier; no final typeface, production typography tokens, O3/wordmark change, CLR-01 reentry, implementation, final identity or Phase-C authority is created.
